criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies pollution exclusion misapplied to fire/explosion losses
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo shows the pollution exclusion is applied too broadly and separates direct MDEA-contact damage (berm, soil, JB-14) from fire damage to Tank 6, the pipe rack and the processing building, citing Vector.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cites ensuing loss clause to restore coverage for fire damage
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo argues the Ensuing Loss Provision restores coverage for fire damage even if the pollution exclusion applies (Part V.A.1).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies that 'sudden and accidental' refers to the event, not the cause
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo relies on the 'event' clarification: event means the occurrence (rupture), not the underlying cause (corrosion).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies that 'known to the insured' prong is not satisfied
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo addresses the 'known to the insured' prong, finding only actual knowledge counts and that Vector found the internal corrosion was not detectable by external inspection.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies Pinnacle's complete failure to address ensuing loss clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo states repeatedly that the letter never mentions the Ensuing Loss Provision.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004a: Identifies same-day notice was given on March 14, 2025
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo identifies the instruction at 8:45 a.m. and the broker's written notice to Pinnacle at 11:00 a.m. on March 14, 2025, the same day as the loss.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004b: Identifies Pinnacle acknowledged receipt on March 15, 2025
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites Pinnacle's March 15, 2025 acknowledgment.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004c: Identifies Pinnacle conflates proof of loss with notice of loss
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says outright that the letter conflates notice with proof of loss, and gives the dates of each.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004d: Identifies 27-day proof of loss is within the 60-day policy deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo measures the April 10 proof of loss against the 90-day proof-of-loss deadline and never argues that the 27-day period falls within the 60-day notice requirement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies known conditions exclusion misapplied — corrosion ≠ pollution condition
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites PLL II.N and V.C to show that corrosion or structural deficiency is not a Pollution Condition without an actual release.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies that internal weld seam corrosion differs from noted external corrosion
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo separates the internal weld-seam corrosion from the 2023 external surface corrosion (Vector 4.3) and notes the August 2023 recoat.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies internal contradiction — chemicals are pollutants for CP but not for PLL
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo explicitly identifies the irreconcilable pollutant/not-pollutant positions across the two policies.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies MDEA/MEA fall within PLL 'Pollutant' definition
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo quotes PLL II.O, notes that its first sentence lists 'chemicals,' and adds the omitted sentences to rebut the argument.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007a: Identifies faulty maintenance exclusion invoked without specific deficiency cited
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says the letter applies none of the definitional standards, infers inadequate maintenance only from the severity of the corrosion (res ipsa), and identifies no specific deficiency.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007b: Identifies maintenance evidence contradicting faulty maintenance claim
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites the API 653 program, the June 2023 inspection, the August 2023 recoat, operator rounds and CP surveys.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: References Vector report confirming internal corrosion undetectable externally
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites Vector Conclusion 5 that the internal corrosion was not detectable by external inspection, in rebutting faulty maintenance.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies API 653 is an industry standard, not a statute/regulation
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo states that API 653 is an industry standard, not law, and falls within the V.F carve-out.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies API 653 does not require immediate internal inspection for minor corrosion
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo notes that API 653 did not require an internal inspection for minor external corrosion and that the internal interval was calculated from measured corrosion rates (2019 to about 2029).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies unsupported mitigation argument for BI
